ambient.implied_cloud_optical_depth_basis: two-stream, g = 0.85: a deck, not a cumulonimbus core (tau 100+ would transmit ~0.12 or less); cross-check only

calibrated_look.ev100_basis: elevation band 14.5 at 28 deg + log2(0.25) deck stops

directional.note: light_lux_outer_space assumes the engine's per-pixel atmosphere transmittance is the ONLY dimming of this light. If the drawn deck also shadows it, the ground value is lower: read the -calibration quad (INTEGRATION.md).
directional.role: the deck's bright patch (storm_soft_sheen), not a sun disc
directional.share_basis: visual-only; exposure is independent of it

exposure.fog_note: a fog or rain veil lit by this sky cannot be brighter than the horizon it hides; a brighter veil lifts the frame's p90 and the meter
exposure.method: manual EV100, constant over the clip

scene_linear_before_tonemap.note: L / (1.2 * 2^EV100); what the tonemapper does to these is UNMEASURED

ground.albedo_wet_basis: visual-only factor on the project's dry albedo

lightning.basis: point source of K * P' * L / (4 pi) cd (core/scene/lightning.py intensity_cd) with the project's first-stroke peak and luminous efficacy; inverse square, no rain extinction
lightning.exposure_rule: the manual EV100 does NOT follow a flash (constant over the clip, the project's no-breathing rule): a stroke is allowed to clip. Peak values are instantaneous; the energy inside one shutter interval is core/scene/lightning.py stroke_energy's, far below peak x shutter.

shared_params.assumed_visibility_owner: haze / rain lanes (an assumption here, not a setting)

sky.lower_hemisphere_note: wet-ground luminance over the sky mean; the project's -storm-lower-hemisphere owner wins where it draws
sky.model: CIE standard overcast sky, L(g) = Lz (1 + 2 sin g) / 3

status: UNMEASURED: computed on the Mac from named formulae; no frame was rendered

tiers.summary: constants only: manual EV100, directional light in lux (unshadowed fill of the deck's bright patch), static SkyLight from the baked overcast cube at 32 px (specified cubemap, no real-time sky capture), lightning as a one-frame SkyLight intensity pulse; no new render targets, no light actors
tier 0 with the 64 px cube and the lightning as ONE unshadowed, inverse-square point light in candela (no shadow maps)
tier 1 with the 128 px cube and the project's storm local-exposure block on (beauty_look.LOCAL_EXPOSURE storm), so the flash keeps cloud detail
tier 2 with the 256 px cube and bloom on the flash; still no real-time sky capture, no Lumen, no shadowed flash
